scope: Two selected historical primary-source summaries, both already exposed; nominal molecular composition and reported calibration/subtraction assumptions retained. Independent Gaussian uncertainty propagation is a supplied summary approximation, not raw likelihood, blind holdout, latest-limit survey or confidence bound.

neutron.source: Baumann, Gaehler, Kalus, Mampe, Phys Rev D37,3107 (1988)
neutron.read_scope: Primary journal abstract: reported neutron charge and uncertainty; fulltext web opening failed, no event-level or full systematic model imported.
neutron.role: One-parameter calibration for the anomaly family.

molecule.source: Bressi et al., Phys Rev A83,052101 (2011), arXiv1102.2766v2
molecule.read_scope: Introduction, Eq1 source combination, measurement/calibration discussion, IVB and conclusions; pages2,3,13 rendered and inspected. Not every intermediate spherical-resonator calculation was rederived.
molecule.role: Exposed development transfer comparison after calibrating from the neutron; optional joint fit separately labelled calibration.
molecule.interpretation: Use s=(Z*x+N*y)/A. The published special interpretation x=y assumes a neutral antineutrino and is not imported into this candidate.
molecule.limits: Nominal isotope/nucleon-mass conversion; polarity-odd subtraction and common acoustic calibration adopted. Unbounded even-polarity nuisance would be degenerate with s.
